function: Joint BS beamforming and RIS phase-shift design that maximizes the multiuser sum-rate (p. 2).
system: BS with M=8 (or 4) antennas, K=4 single-antenna users, passive reflecting RIS with N=96 (or 16) unit-cells, narrowband, ULAs; carrier frequency not stated (p. 1, 4).
method: Three separately trained CNN-based networks (PhaseNet with 3D residual+SE blocks, BeamNet, fine-tuning BeamNet); semi-supervised: sum-rate loss plus NMSE to BCD labels; iterative inference (p. 2-3).
data_channel: Own simulated Rician channels (factor 10, ULAs), setup of [3]; BS (0,0) m, RIS (200,10) m, users in 10 m circle; 76544 training, 256 validation realizations (p. 1-2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained and validated on the same simulated distribution (K=4; M=8,N=96 and M=4,N=16), averaged over 256 validation realizations, sweeping transmit power PT (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: BCD [3], WMMSE-based (PN+WMMSE)-IE; learned: two-stage PhaseNet/BeamNet [6], Transformer RAUB-TF [9], RL-DDPG [10] (p. 4-5).
metrics: Sum-rate (nats) versus transmit power PT, ranked individual user rates for fairness, simulation/inference time ratio zeta relative to SST-IE (p. 4-5).
complexity: Parameter counts of PN, BN, FBN in Table I (about 10^5 to 10^6 each) and runtime ratios, e.g. SST-IE (2) about 27x faster than BCD (100) (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 1: "We consider a narrowband channel model [3]"; p. 4: "Channel generation follows the setup in [3]". Custom Rician simulator with ULAs; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "averaged over 256 validation channel realizations" from the same setup. The two configurations (M=8,N=96 and M=4,N=16) are separate setups with their own network sizes (Table I note); no test in a condition unseen in training is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "the conventional optimization-based BCD algorithm [3] and the neural network based two-stage method [6]"; p. 5: "compare the performance of SST-IE with BCD, RAUB-TF [9], and RL-DDPG [10]". Sum-rate is compared in Fig. 5.
q4_support: p. 4: "SST-IE (2) also outperforms BCD (100), while being about 27× faster" (measured simulation time); Table I on p. 4 also gives the number of parameters of BN, PN and FBN.
q5_support: p. 4: "We generate 76544 channel realizations for training". The channels are self-generated; no code or data link, DOI, public dataset or measured data appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Letter on RIS-aided multiuser MISO downlink, area 3 (beamforming and RIS phase shifts). Labels for the supervised term are BCD solutions at iterations 0, 25, 100, 500 (p. 2). Table I and Fig. 5 are images, read from PDF pages 4 and 5. Frequency band not stated; only the bandwidth 180 kHz (p. 4).
